operators.name: Modal successor
operators.action: Re-root the unchanged pitch-class set at its next ascending scale tone.

operators.name: Raise root phase by one semitone
operators.domain_rule: Defined when pitch class 1 is absent; replace root 0 with 1 and renormalize by -1.
operators.action: Move the tonic seam one semitone, retain the other six absolute pitches, then renormalize the new root to 0.

operators.name: Lower root phase by one semitone
operators.domain_rule: Defined when pitch class 11 is absent; replace root 0 with 11 and renormalize by +1.
operators.action: Move the tonic seam one semitone, retain the other six absolute pitches, then renormalize the new root to 0.

operators.name: Raise Degree 2 by one semitone

operators.action: Replace the pitch at ordered Degree 2 by +1 semitone.

operators.name: Lower Degree 2 by one semitone
operators.domain_rule: Defined when Degree 2 can move down one semitone without collision or crossing the rooted boundary.
operators.action: Replace the pitch at ordered Degree 2 by -1 semitone.
